description: "Apologia Pro Vita Sua" by John Henry Newman is a religious autobiography published in 1864. Written in response to accusations of dishonesty regarding his conversion from Anglicanism to Catholicism, Newman traces the evolution of his religious beliefs and defends his integrity.
